interval_rule: Newcombe (1998b, Stat Med 17:2635-2650) paired-difference method 10, two-sided 95%. Closed form: with discordant counts b (new-only reject) and c (old-only reject), concordant counts e (both) and h (neither), n=e+b+c+h, d=(b-c)/n, p_b=(e+b)/n, p_c=(e+c)/n, phi=(e*h-b*c)/sqrt((e+b)(c+h)(e+c)(b+h)) (continuity-corrected numerator max(e*h-b*c-n/2,0) when e*h>b*c; phi=0 when the denominator vanishes), and (l_b,u_b),(l_c,u_c) the Wilson score bounds of p_b,p_c: CI = [d-sqrt((p_b-l_b)^2-2*phi*(p_b-l_b)*(u_c-p_c)+(u_c-p_c)^2), d+sqrt((u_b-p_b)^2-2*phi*(u_b-p_b)*(p_c-l_c)+(p_c-l_c)^2)]. ZCode provides an independent Python second implementation for cross-checking

items.label: attenuation
items.text: Attenuation: the paired 95% Newcombe confidence interval for FPR at the high-density schedule minus FPR at the original schedule has an upper bound no greater than -0.05.

items.label: indeterminate
items.text: The density perturbation did not yield a decisive attenuation or persistence verdict under the preregistered precision rule.
